intro: In Darnassus, the armorer Mathiel collaborates with the dwarven smith Furen Longbeard to refine a new mailcrafting technique. He tasks warriors with traveling to Thousand Needles to gather durable wyvern eggshells from the heights of Highperch.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My colleague, Furen Longbeard, made a discovery which I am eager to test. I wish to try it on a new armor that I am researching, for I believe Furen's techniques will produce superior results.
Will you help me? If you gather what I need to make the armor, then I will make an extra piece for you.
I need the sunscorched egg shells of the Highperch Wyverns who dwell at Highperch, in Thousand Needles. Search for the shells below their nests, and return to me when you have a sufficient amount.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the shells, friend? They are quite strong, and can be rendered into a lacquer I will use to coat the links of my new mail armor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, thank you. These will work splendidly!
I will begin fashioning the armor immediately...
